content:
incident-bot: ALERT: High restart rate detected on inference-runtime-prod. PagerDuty PDR-8421 triggered for repeated container restarts on GPU nodes (eastus). Affected autoscaling group: gpu-pool-eastus. Please ack and investigate. https://pd.example/PDR-8421

ops-runner: Deploy bot: release/2026.03.15 model-cache-v2 rolled at 02:13 UTC to inference-runtime-prod (sha:abc123). No automatic rollback.

Tasha (oncall): taking pager, jumping in now.

ryan (sre): seeing continuous container restarts on node gpu-54. Logs show CUDA OOM during prefill stage for long-context requests.

ryan (sre): logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T02:06:11Z] runtime: starting prefill, req_id=6f3a, model=assistant-large, prefill_tokens=131072, seq_len=131072
[2026-03-15T02:06:12Z] runtime: allocate kv_cache 24.0GB -> success
[2026-03-15T02:06:12Z] runtime: CUDA error: out of memory (cuMemAlloc)
[2026-03-15T02:06:12Z] runtime: terminating process due to uncaught exception
[2026-03-15T02:06:13Z] kubelet: container restart observed: inference-runtime-abc (ExitCode 137)
[2026-03-15T02:06:15Z] kubelet: pod rescheduled on gpu-59
```

micah (infra): node gpu-54 shows kubelet restart events right after the OOMs — could be node-level instability causing flapping. I'm checking node metrics (OOM killer, docker daemon).

alex (eng-runtime): did we change any KV cache sizing or model config in the recent rollout? The release note mentioned cache optimizations.

ops-runner: release/2026.03.15 changelog: "model-cache-v2: larger prefetch window, dynamic kv cache growth" (author: @alex).

alex (eng-runtime): yep that was the change. Looks like dynamic growth allowed very large prefill allocations when clients send huge contexts. We didn't cap prefill tokens at the runtime surface.

ops-runner: release/2026.03.15 changelog: "model-cache-v2: larger prefetch window, dynamic kv cache growth" (author: @alex).

alex (eng-runtime): preparing runtime hotpatch. Pushing config to canary then prod:
```json
{"runtime":{"prefill_max_tokens":8192,"prefill_trim_strategy":"right-trim","fallback_model":"assistant-large-quant"}}
```

ryan (sre): enabling model fallback rule for requests with prefill>8192 to route to assistant-large-quant (8-bit).

Tasha (oncall): alex, what quality impact do we expect from assistant-large-quant?

alex (eng-runtime): small probability of hallucinations on very long contexts, but empirical evals show ~1-2% quality delta for our eval sets. Preferable to repeated restarts.

ops-runner: Scaling action: increased gpu-pool-eastus desired=+2 for 30m (autoscaler override).

ryan (sre): monitoring metrics now: restart rate trending down, error rate for inference-prod dropping from 12% -> 2% over last 8m. Token processing latency stable.

Tasha (oncall): good. Customer-impact: CS to email affected customers with mitigation note and ETA for stable fix.

customer-success: will send consolidated update in 10m.

micah (infra): note: node gpu-54 kernel logs show repeated oom_kill for process `runtime`. Suspect memory leak when dynamic kv cache grows past threshold. Adding to follow-up.

alex (eng-runtime): follow-ups: add server-side prefill sanity checks (reject >prefill_max_hard=131072 at ingress), and add guard rails to dynamic growth to respect available GPU mem. I'll make a PR and tag ryan for review.

ryan (sre): assigning postmortem owner: ryan. Action items: (ryan) postmortem, (alex) PR for guard rails, (micah) node health audit, (customer-success) customer outreach.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 20m. Next oncall: micah (infra).

Tasha (oncall): handover in 18m. Current status: mitigations applied (prefill cap, fallback routing, node cordoned, pool scaled). Observed customer errors down to baseline and no new restarts in last 9m. Will update PD after handoff. :thumbsup:

ryan (sre): saving logs and attaching to PD ticket PDR-8421. Will add timing and root-cause hypothesis to the postmortem.

customer-success: update sent to affected accounts: "We've applied temporary limits and fallback routing to ensure service stability; we'll follow up with a timeline for a full fix."

micah (infra): leaving monitoring hooks on gpu-pool-eastus and will watch for node reappearance.

Tasha (oncall): closing slack thread for active coordination. Marking as 'mitigated' for now. Follow-ups tracked in ticket: PDR-8421.

ryan (sre): final note: do not revert model-cache-v2 until guard rails are in place.

ops-runner: Incident summary (auto): cause suspected dynamic kv cache growth + large client prefill -> GPU OOM -> container restarts; mitigations: prefill cap hotpatch, fallback routing to quant variant, node cordon/drain, temporary scale-up. Postmortem owner assigned.

Tasha (oncall): thanks team. I'll hand off to micah in 15m and keep an eye on PD thread.
